assumptions.statement: Site boundary is provisional (provisional_constraint, official_boundary=false); official redline not yet provided.
assumptions.impact: All areas and ratios (site_area_sqm, green_ratio, public_space_ratio, land_use partition, phasing) must be recalculated when the official boundary is supplied.

assumptions.statement: Three key areas (zhongzhiyuan, beijing_ai_origin_community, dazhongsi) use provisional rough polygons; official polygons not yet provided.
assumptions.impact: Key-area areas and detailed-design conclusions are provisional and must be redrawn to official polygons before statutory use.

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls (FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines, facility standards) and municipal/engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments.
assumptions.impact: The package is reviewable for provided geometry and narrative only; control metrics remain unknown (待正式数据补齐).
assumptions.recompute_trigger: official control plan / infrastructure data supplied

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are conceptual capacity illustrations generated from the land-use partition; they are not existing buildings, ownership, or demolition conclusions.
assumptions.impact: building_footprint_area_sqm and building_count are indicative only; retain/renovate/demolish must follow official condition surveys.

assumptions.statement: AI scenarios, landmarks, event systems, and operations are conceptual suggestions for professional teams to deepen; they are not approved government activities, confirmed arrangements, or investment commitments.
assumptions.impact: No operational or financial outcome is claimed; all such content must be treated as reference schemes.
assumptions.recompute_trigger: organizer/professional team deepens and confirms scope

assumptions.statement: Road centerlines are representative corridor lines within the provisional boundary for design discussion only; they are not official road redlines.
assumptions.impact: Transport conclusions are temporary design discussion until official road/rail/municipal data is supplied.
assumptions.recompute_trigger: official road network / control data supplied
